description: Factors must never be categorized, labeled, or output as buy/sell signals.
No factor value shall imply certainty of upward or downward price movement.
Factors must not be automatically compiled into threshold-based trading rules.
Factors must not serve as ground-truth target variables or class labels in this phase.

policy_name: Prohibition of Broker or Order Routing
description: Zero integration with execution brokers, live APIs, or order dispatchers.
